evals.prompt: My Nautilus 0.63.0 replay batches mix data kinds, assuming add_data validates every item. I also plan to configure any custom payload through BacktestDataConfig, and to warm indicators through basic backtest historical requests. What must change?
evals.expected_output: Enforce homogeneous validated batches, use the actual custom-data ingestion path and supply warm-up records explicitly.
assertions: add_data checks the first item and assumes homogeneity; validate or partition the whole batch.
Arbitrary custom types are not BacktestDataConfig variants; use explicit custom ingestion and recognize dynamic query materialization.
Basic historical quote/trade/bar backtest request methods are no-ops, so warm-up requires explicit available prior input.
